title: Snazzie FM News: The Migration Files
description: The annual migration has reversed direction and no animal will say why. Anchors Dale Crisp and Marsha Veld track the unionized pigeons and the geese annexation of the south reservoir, while the birds keep circling the station and refusing to land.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Top of the hour on Snazzie F M News. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Our top story, the annual migration has reversed direction, and so far no animal will say why.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: We're working to confirm that, Marsha. The birds have been circling the station for three hours and declining to land.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: In labor news, the city's pigeons have unionized and are now invoicing residents for aerial coverage, payable in seed or equity.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Their office did not return our calls. <p:0.3> Though one did land on the windowsill and leave an invoice.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Parks confirms the geese have annexed the south reservoir, and are issuing their own parking permits.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Officials urge residents to comply. The geese are honest brokers, Marsha. They simply do not refund.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Still no word on why the migration turned around. And finally. <p:0.3> The deer at the tree line were asked to disperse.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: They declined, politely, and have begun taking attendance.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Officials say there is no cause for alarm. Only for counting.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: We'll know more once the deer tell us how many of us there are. <p:0.3> For Snazzie F M News, I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Stay counted.
